title: Historical bounded ZQX native execution probe — unmerged diagnostic only

accepted_artifacts.label: Product lane state cache
accepted_artifacts.note: State cache itself says it is as of an earlier Product commit; live issues and accepted main artifacts remain authoritative.

conflicts_and_limitations: The reported numeric results come from draft PR #289, which remains unmerged, not from accepted main implementation.
The PR body reports 392 tests passed in a historical workflow, but this task did not invoke GitHub Actions or independently rerun those tests.
Issue #288 is closed as deferred/superseded by #291; the probe is not the active Product work unit.
The 12/12 major-star comparison and 80-year zero-difference comparison are bounded to the fields and input normalization described by the PR.
The production temporal reaction registry and manifestation/probability registries were empty in the diagnostic baseline; no predictive validity or calibration is established.
wording_ceiling: Draft PR #289 reports a bounded diagnostic of chart computation, annual snapshots and wealth-rule activation. Its results remain unmerged historical diagnostic evidence, not accepted main runtime or predictive-validity evidence.
forbidden_inferences: The diagnostic is part of accepted main runtime.
15 active wealth rules mean 15 real-world events or probabilities.
Zero differences over the tested snapshots prove all chart outputs are identical.
An empty reaction registry means a negative event prediction.
Historical workflow results establish predictive validity or causal effects.
